# Go codegen for map<K,V> for-loop: emits for k, v := range m { ... }

sngl generate --platform=bubbletea --lang=go --out=out app.sngl
exists out/model.go

# Handler contains a range-over-map loop.
grep 'for .* := range' out/model.go

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

output { go { bubbletea } }

component main {
    var scores map<string, int> = {alice = 10, bob = 20}
    var total = 0
    button(text="sum", @click {
        for var k, v = scores {
            total = total + v
        }
    })
    text(value=string(total))
}
